properties.critique_prompt:
Merge and review these sub-agent outputs:

Sub-Agent A result:
{{previous_output}}

Evaluate the merged result for:
1. Consistency — Do the results agree? (1–10)
2. Coverage — Is {{task}} fully addressed? (1–10)
3. Quality — Is the output actionable? (1–10)

Provide a unified, coherent final output. If score < {{quality_threshold}}, revise.

- Use parameterized queries for safety
